title: RepoTrace: Improving Requirement Tracing in Multi-Round Agent Interactions
title_zh: RepoTrace：改进多轮智能体交互中的需求追踪

paragraphs.en: Code agents have become increasingly capable of performing software engineering tasks through interaction with software environments. However, agents tend to degrade as the number of interaction rounds increases, making it difficult to maintain existing software during iterative modification. We analyze 2,656 agent trajectories in EvoCode-Bench and identify requirement focus misalignment as a recurring failure pattern, where agents struggle to distinguish the primary modification targets of a requirement from unrelated code.
paragraphs.zh: 代码智能体通过与环境交互执行软件工程任务的能力日益增强。 然而，随着交互轮数的增加，智能体的表现往往会退化，这使得在迭代修改过程中维护现有软件变得困难。 我们分析了 EvoCode-Bench 中的 2,656 条智能体轨迹，发现需求焦点错位是一种反复出现的失败模式，即智能体难以区分需求的主要修改目标与无关代码。

paragraphs.en: We propose RepoTrace , a requirement-driven repository understanding harness that combines repository structure with requirement semantics to construct a requirement-code correspondence and injects it into the agent context. This correspondence enables code agents to follow the repository architecture, trace requirements across multi-round interactions, and identify the core code elements corresponding to the current requirement. Experiments show that RepoTrace improves the mean per-round reward (MPR) across different models ( e.g., +19.99 on GLM-5.2) and agent harnesses ( e.g., +10.22 on Claude Code). Across rounds, RepoTrace increases the average per-round reward from 0.163 to 0.371 on Terminus-2 with DeepSeek-V4-Pro, while reducing average regression errors by 56.78%. We release the source code and agents’ trajectories to support future research 1 1 1 https://github.com/gtxygyzb/RepoTrace .
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 RepoTrace，一个需求驱动的仓库理解框架，它将仓库结构与需求语义相结合以构建需求-代码对应关系，并将其注入智能体上下文。 这种对应关系使代码智能体能够遵循仓库架构、在多轮交互中追踪需求，并识别与当前需求对应的核心代码元素。 实验表明，RepoTrace 在不同模型（例如 GLM-5.2 上 +19.99）和智能体框架（例如 Claude Code 上 +10.22）上均提升了平均每轮奖励（MPR）。 在各轮次中，RepoTrace 在 Terminus-2 搭配 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 上将平均每轮奖励从 0.163 提升至 0.371，同时将平均回归误差降低了 56.78%。 我们开源了源代码和智能体的轨迹以支持未来研究 1 1 1 https://github.com/gtxygyzb/RepoTrace 。

paragraphs.en: Recently, code agents have become increasingly capable of performing software engineering tasks through interaction with software environments ( Anthropic, 2026b ; OpenAI, 2026 ) . A harness enables code agents to observe the environment, use tools, execute actions, receive execution feedback, and update memory ( Sumers et al., 2024 ) . Through multi-round interaction with the environment, code agents have demonstrated strong capabilities in repository-level code generation, vulnerability discovery, and software testing ( Anthropic, 2026a ; Carlini et al., 2026 ; Maaz et al., 2026 ) . Vibe coding shifts software development from one-shot code generation to iterative modification of existing software systems ( Tang et al., 2026 ) , where software maintenance and evolution are also important parts of the software life cycle ( Lehman, 1980 ; Lientz et al., 1978 ) . Future software development requires agents not only to satisfy current user requirements, but also to understand the architecture of existing repositories and the potential impact of their modifications.
paragraphs.zh: 近年来，代码智能体通过与软件环境交互来执行软件工程任务的能力日益增强（Anthropic, 2026b; OpenAI, 2026）。 框架（harness）使代码智能体能够观察环境、使用工具、执行操作、接收执行反馈并更新记忆（Sumers et al., 2024）。 通过与环境的多轮交互，代码智能体在仓库级代码生成、漏洞发现和软件测试方面已展现出强大的能力（Anthropic, 2026a; Carlini et al., 2026; Maaz et al., 2026）。 氛围编程（vibe coding）将软件开发从一次性代码生成转变为对现有软件系统的迭代修改（Tang et al., 2026），而软件维护与演化也是软件生命周期的重要组成部分（Lehman, 1980; Lientz et al., 1978）。 未来的软件开发要求智能体不仅要满足当前的用户需求，还要理解现有仓库的架构以及其修改可能带来的影响。

paragraphs.en: However, recent studies show that code agents tend to degrade as the number of interaction rounds increases in complex multi-round software engineering tasks ( Shen et al., 2026 ; Huang et al., 2026 ; Orlanski et al., 2026 ; Laban et al., 2025 ) . For example, EvoCode-Bench ( Shen et al., 2026 ) contains 26 stateful tasks and 227 interaction rounds from 12 mainstream code agents. The analysis of failure cases shows that the test pass rate decreases from 46.7% in early rounds to 7.7% in later rounds. Regression Accumulation ( Huang et al., 2026 ) evaluates 542 tasks over 8 rounds, covering 26,016 interaction instances, and reports that 40%–73% of tasks lose previously satisfied behaviors during multi-round interactions.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，近期研究表明，在复杂的多轮软件工程任务中，随着交互轮数的增加，代码智能体的表现往往会下降 ( Shen et al., 2026 ; Huang et al., 2026 ; Orlanski et al., 2026 ; Laban et al., 2025 ) 。 例如，EvoCode-Bench ( Shen et al., 2026 ) 包含来自 12 个主流代码智能体的 26 个有状态任务和 227 个交互轮次。 对失败案例的分析表明，测试通过率从早期的 46.7% 下降到后期的 7.7%。 回归累积 ( Huang et al., 2026 ) 在 8 轮中评估了 542 个任务，涵盖 26,016 个交互实例，并报告称在多轮交互过程中，40%–73% 的任务会丢失先前已满足的行为。

paragraphs.en: Software has two fundamental properties: constructivity and evolvability ( Yang, 2005 ; Breivold et al., 2012 ) . Constructivity refers to building software systems that satisfy functional goals based on requirements. Evolvability refers to the ability of software systems to iteratively adapt to changes in requirements, environments, and technologies while maintaining system integrity and consistency. The challenges introduced by software evolvability receive more and more attention, including architecture maintenance and dependency management ( Gu et al., 2026 ) . Recent studies have explored self-evolving software and recursive self-improvement (RSI), further demonstrating the importance of evolvability ( Zhang et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026a ; Zhou, 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 软件具有两个基本属性：可构造性和可演化性（Yang, 2005；Breivold et al., 2012）。 可构造性指的是根据需求构建满足功能目标的软件系统。 可演化性指的是软件系统在保持系统完整性和一致性的同时，迭代地适应需求、环境和技术变化的能力。 软件可演化性带来的挑战受到越来越多的关注，包括架构维护和依赖管理（Gu et al., 2026）。 近期的研究已经探索了自演化软件和递归自我改进（RSI），进一步证明了可演化性的重要性（Zhang et al., 2026；Liu et al., 2026a；Zhou, 2026）。

paragraphs.en: To further understand the challenges faced by code agents during multi-round interactions, we systematically analyze 2,656 agent trajectories from EvoCode-Bench. We identify requirement focus misalignment as a recurring failure pattern. Specifically, code agents struggle to distinguish the primary modification targets of a requirement from related code elements ( e.g., classes, functions, and files) that do not require direct modification. As a result, code agents may modify unrelated code or miss necessary synchronized updates. Across failure rounds, 55.16% of code modifications occur outside the modification target files specified by the human oracle (see Section 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 为了进一步理解代码智能体在多轮交互中面临的挑战，我们系统地分析了来自 EvoCode-Bench 的 2,656 条智能体轨迹。 我们发现需求焦点错位是一种反复出现的失败模式。 具体而言，代码智能体难以区分需求的主要修改目标与那些无需直接修改的相关代码元素（例如类、函数和文件）。 因此，代码智能体可能会修改无关代码，或遗漏必要的同步更新。 在各失败轮次中，55.16% 的代码修改发生在人工标准答案所指定的修改目标文件之外（见第 2 节）。

paragraphs.en: To this end, we propose RepoTrace , a requirement-driven repository understanding harness that improves requirement tracing for code agents in multi-round software tasks. The core idea of RepoTrace is to explicitly guide code agents to establish the correspondence between requirements and the code repository before code modification. Specifically, RepoTrace first builds a structural representation of the code repository from code relations and computes a structural weight for each code element. The weights help identify core elements, extension points, and change propagation across the repository. Next, RepoTrace extracts the potential modification scope from the semantics of the natural-language requirement. Finally, RepoTrace combines requirement semantics with repository structure to construct a requirement-code correspondence and injects it into the agent context. RepoTrace allows code agents to trace the repository architecture across rounds and identify the core code elements corresponding to the current requirements.
paragraphs.zh: 为此，我们提出 RepoTrace，一个需求驱动的仓库理解框架，用于改善代码智能体在多轮软件任务中的需求追踪。 RepoTrace 的核心思想是在代码修改之前，显式引导代码智能体建立需求与代码仓库之间的对应关系。 具体而言，RepoTrace 首先根据代码关系构建代码仓库的结构化表示，并为每个代码元素计算结构权重。 这些权重有助于识别核心元素、扩展点以及整个仓库中的变更传播。 接着，RepoTrace 从自然语言需求的语义中提取潜在的修改范围。 最后，RepoTrace 将需求语义与仓库结构相结合，构建需求-代码对应关系，并将其注入智能体上下文中。 RepoTrace 使代码智能体能够在多轮之间追踪仓库架构，并识别与当前需求相对应的核心代码元素。

paragraphs.en: Experimental results show that RepoTrace improves performance across models and harnesses in multi-round interactions, and reduces regression errors.
paragraphs.zh: 实验结果表明，RepoTrace 在多轮交互中提升了各模型和测试框架的性能，并减少了回归错误。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we use two real-world examples of multi-round repository modification to illustrate requirement focus misalignment : code agents modify unrelated code or omit necessary updates. The examples are from real-world software development tasks in EvoCode-Bench ( Shen et al., 2026 ) and include human-written oracle solutions.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们使用两个真实世界的多轮仓库修改示例来说明需求焦点错位：智能体修改了无关代码，或遗漏了必要的更新。 这些示例来自 EvoCode-Bench（Shen 等，2026）中的真实软件开发任务，并包含人工编写的标准解答。

paragraphs.en: ❶ Unrelated code modification. In Figure 1 (a), the requirement asks the agent to update the rollback behavior and add the snapshot() and restore() functions. The human-written oracle modifies the corresponding logic in pipeline.sh . During the rewrite, the agent omits the existing validate() command and breaks the validation functionality.

paragraphs.en: ❷ Missing update. In Figure 1 (b), the requirement asks each detected anomaly to include an evidence object. paragraphs.en: Code agents have demonstrated strong capabilities in software engineering tasks. Commercial products such as Claude Code, Codex and Kimi Code ( Anthropic, 2026b ; OpenAI, 2026 ; Moonshot AI, 2026 ) bring agentic coding into daily development practice. From function-level HumanEval ( Chen et al., 2021 ) , to repository-level SWE-bench ( OpenAI, 2024 ; Deng et al., 2025 ) , to long-horizon tasks like Terminal-Bench ( Merrill et al., 2026 ) , code agents continuously achieve high scores. Many existing benchmarks focus on single-round, one-shot code generation, where software maintenance and evolution remain important throughout the software life cycle ( Lehman, 1980 ; Lientz et al., 1978 ) . However, recent studies show that code agents tend to degrade as the number of interaction rounds increases. Laban et al. (2025) finds that top-tier models lose roughly 39% of their average success rate compared to single-round settings, and Rawal et al. (2025) reports a 20%-27% average drop in correct-and-secure outputs across 32 models. Similarly, SlopCodeBench reports that no agent solves all tasks, where the best agent passes only 14.8% of checkpoints, and 77% of trajectories exhibit structural erosion, while 75.5% suffer from verbosity ( Orlanski et al., 2026 ) . Complementary studies report consistent findings, including declining accuracy under iterative refinement, low completion rates under stepwise requirement refinement, instruction forgetting, and progressive faithfulness loss to emergent specifications ( Wang et al., 2026 ; Zhan et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Yan et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 代码智能体已在软件工程任务中展现出强大的能力。 Claude Code、Codex 和 Kimi Code 等商业产品（Anthropic, 2026b；OpenAI, 2026；Moonshot AI, 2026）将智能体编程带入了日常开发实践。 从函数级别的 HumanEval（Chen et al., 2021），到仓库级别的 SWE-bench（OpenAI, 2024；Deng et al., 2025），再到 Terminal-Bench 这类长程任务（Merrill et al., 2026），代码智能体不断取得高分。 许多现有基准聚焦于单轮、一次性的代码生成，而在整个软件生命周期中，软件维护与演化始终十分重要（Lehman, 1980；Lientz et al., 1978）。 然而，近期研究表明，随着交互轮数的增加，代码智能体的表现往往下降。Laban et al. (2025) 发现，与单轮设置相比，顶级模型的平均成功率损失约 39%，Rawal et al. (2025) 报告称，32 个模型的正确且安全输出的平均下降幅度为 20%-27%。 类似地，SlopCodeBench 报告称没有任何智能体能解决全部任务，其中表现最好的智能体仅通过 14.8% 的检查点，77% 的轨迹出现结构性退化，而 75.5% 存在冗长问题（Orlanski et al., 2026）。 补充性研究也报告了一致的发现，包括迭代精炼下准确率的下降、逐步需求精炼下低完成率、指令遗忘，以及对涌现规范的渐进性忠实度损失（Wang et al., 2026；Zhan et al., 2025；Wang et al., 2025；Yan et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: Requirements traceability refers to the ability to describe and follow the life of a requirement ( Gotel and Finkelstein, 1994 ) , which is an active research topic in software engineering. Recent studies explore the combination of LLMs with structured methods for requirements tracing. TraceDev proposes a multi-agent framework that links requirements, design models, and code in a heterogeneous traceability graph to explicitly maintain consistency among software artifacts ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . RAG-based methods further recover requirement trace links in a largely domain-agnostic manner ( Hey et al., 2025 ; Fuchß et al., 2025 ) . Existing studies demonstrate the potential of language models in requirements tracing and the impact analysis of change ( Etezadi et al., 2025 ) . However, they don’t consider how requirement-artifact consistency should be maintained as requirements evolve over multiple rounds of development.
paragraphs.zh: 需求可追溯性是指描述并跟踪需求生命周期（Gotel and Finkelstein, 1994）的能力，这是软件工程领域的一个活跃研究课题。 近期研究探索将大语言模型与结构化方法相结合以进行需求追溯。 TraceDev 提出了一个多智能体框架，将需求、设计模型和代码关联在异构可追溯性图中，以显式维护软件制品之间的一致性（Chen et al., 2026）。 基于检索增强生成（RAG）的方法进一步以在很大程度上与领域无关的方式恢复需求追溯链接（Hey et al., 2025; Fuchß et al., 2025）。 现有研究展示了语言模型在需求追溯以及变更影响分析方面的潜力（Etezadi et al., 2025）。 然而，这些研究并未考虑随着需求在多轮开发过程中不断演化，需求与制品之间的一致性应如何维护。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, repository-level code understanding is another key research direction. GraphCoder proposes the code context graph (CCG), which structures information such as control flow and data dependencies into a graph to improve context retrieval for repository-level code completion ( Liu et al., 2024 ) . CodexGraph and RANGER organize repositories as knowledge graphs, supporting graph queries and natural-language retrieval ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Shah et al., 2025 ) . Most recently, LocAgent and DyRetriever allow agents to navigate or perform multi-hop reasoning along dependency graphs, achieving low-cost code localization and context retrieval ( Chen et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026b ) . Existing methods enhance the understanding of code structure from different angles ( Luo et al., 2025 ) . However, they primarily target static repositories or one-shot generation, without considering how repository structure should be maintained and updated during multi-round interactions.
paragraphs.zh: 与此同时，仓库级代码理解是另一个重要的研究方向。 GraphCoder 提出了代码上下文图（CCG），将控制流和数据依赖等信息结构化为图，以改进仓库级代码补全的上下文检索（Liu et al., 2024）。 CodexGraph 和 RANGER 将仓库组织为知识图谱，支持图查询和自然语言检索（Liu et al., 2025; Shah et al., 2025）。 最近，LocAgent 和 DyRetriever 允许智能体沿依赖图进行导航或多跳推理，实现低成本的代码定位和上下文检索（Chen et al., 2025; Liu et al., 2026b）。 现有方法从不同角度增强了对代码结构的理解（Luo et al., 2025）。 然而，这些方法主要面向静态仓库或一次性生成，没有考虑在多轮交互过程中仓库结构应如何维护和更新。

paragraphs.en: We propose RepoTrace , a requirement-driven repository understanding harness for code agents in multi-round interactions. To address requirement focus misalignment, RepoTrace combines repository structure with requirement semantics before code modification. The agent receives the current requirement together with structural dependencies and information about code elements associated with prior requirements.

sents.en: The following subsections introduce three steps: ❶ how RepoTrace constructs a structural representation G t G_{t} of the repository; ❷ how RepoTrace extracts requirement entities Q t Q_{t} using the current requirement, the structural representation G t G_{t} , and prior requirement records; and ❸ how RepoTrace combines G t G_{t} and Q t Q_{t} to construct a requirement-code correspondence message M t M_{t} , maintain requirement tracing across rounds.
sents.zh: 以下小节介绍三个步骤：❶ RepoTrace 如何构建仓库的结构表示 G t G_{t} ；❷ RepoTrace 如何利用当前需求、结构表示 G t G_{t} 以及先前的需求记录提取需求实体 Q t Q_{t} ；❸ RepoTrace 如何结合 G t G_{t} 和 Q t Q_{t} 构建需求-代码对应消息 M t M_{t} ，并在各轮之间维护需求追踪。

paragraphs.en: Let V t V_{t} denote the set of source files collected from R t R_{t} , and let E t E_{t} denote the collected directed file relations. A relation ( u , v ) ∈ E t (u,v)\in E_{t} indicates that file u u refers to code in file v v . The representation G t G_{t} contains these file and relation sets, an index that associates symbols with their defining files, and file-level structural weights. To obtain G t G_{t} , we first extract the relations and symbol index, then compute the structural weights. We also compare G t G_{t} with the previous representation to identify structural changes across rounds.

paragraphs.en: To obtain the file relations and symbol index, RepoTrace collects source-file paths, import declarations, symbol definitions, and candidate call sites from R t R_{t} . Specifically, we record ( u , v ) (u,v) when file u u imports code from file v v or contains a candidate call site whose name matches a symbol defined in v v . We resolve repository-local imports and aggregate matched calls into file relations. These relations provide an approximate structural view, and the symbol index connects names in a requirement to repository files.
paragraphs.zh: 为获取文件关系与符号索引，RepoTrace 从 R t R_{t} 中收集源文件路径、导入声明、符号定义以及候选调用点。 具体而言，当文件 u u 从文件 v v 导入代码，或包含一个名称与 v v 中定义的符号相匹配的候选调用点时，我们就记录 ( u , v ) (u,v)。 我们解析仓库内部的导入，并将匹配到的调用聚合为文件关系。 这些关系提供了一个近似的结构视图，而符号索引将需求中的名称连接到仓库文件。

paragraphs.en: To identify core files that may affect dependent files, we compute two structural scores from code relations. We apply PageRank ( Page et al., 1999 ) to the file graph formed by nodes V t V_{t} and relations from E t E_{t} whose endpoints are both in V t V_{t} . We also compute the fan-in of each file, defined as the number of distinct files that refer to it. PageRank captures the structural importance of files in the dependency graph, while fan-in measures how many files directly depend on each file. We use PageRank to prioritize files included in the LLM prompt and to order examples of dependent files. We use fan-in to select files referenced by multiple files and to rank the existing-file overview in the agent context. Two scores expose structural dependencies without assuming that structurally important files require modification.
paragraphs.zh: 为了识别可能影响依赖文件的核心文件，我们基于代码关系计算两个结构化分数。 我们将 PageRank（Page et al., 1999）应用于由节点 V t V_{t} 以及端点均位于 V t V_{t} 中的 E t E_{t} 关系所构成的文件图。 我们还计算每个文件的入度（fan-in），定义为引用它的不同文件的数量。 PageRank 刻画了文件在依赖图中的结构重要性，而入度衡量每个文件被多少文件直接依赖。 我们使用 PageRank 对包含在 LLM 提示词中的文件进行优先级排序，并对依赖文件的示例进行排序。 我们使用入度来选择被多个文件引用的文件，并对智能体上下文中现有文件的概览进行排序。 这两个分数揭示了结构上的依赖关系，而无需假设结构上重要的文件需要修改。

paragraphs.en: ❶For LLM-based extraction, RepoTrace calls an LLM to analyze the current requirement, a list of files ranked by PageRank, symbol-to-file associations, and a bounded summary of recent requirement records. When prior records exist, RepoTrace also includes a compact summary of Δ t \Delta_{t} in the prompt. The LLM extracts the requirement entities and returns the structured record Q t Q_{t} . ❷ If no LLM is configured or extraction fails, a keyword fallback matches file paths and identifiers in r t r_{t} against the repository index. The fallback compares these matches with historical targets to distinguish newly identified targets from potentially affected prior code elements without using Δ t \Delta_{t} . In both paths, the records retain associations between requirements and code elements across rounds. For specific examples, see Appendix A.2 .

paragraphs.en: To reuse the current analysis in later rounds, RepoTrace stores the current graph representation and appends the current requirement record to its history after constructing M t M_{t} and before the code agent executes. The agent then modifies the repository, whose state is observed as R t + 1 R_{t+1} at the next round. At that round, RepoTrace reconstructs the repository structure, compares it with the retained graph, and reuses prior requirement records during extraction, repeating the three steps for the next requirement. paragraphs.en: To evaluate the effectiveness of RepoTrace , we conduct experiments with multiple code agents on multi-round software tasks. In this section, we introduce the benchmarks, baselines, models, and evaluation metrics. We then present the experimental results and analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估 RepoTrace 的有效性，我们在多轮软件任务上使用多个智能体进行了实验。 在本节中，我们介绍基准测试、基线方法、模型和评估指标。 然后我们给出实验结果与分析。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate code agents on EvoCode-Bench ( Shen et al., 2026 ) , which contains 26 stateful software engineering tasks and 227 evaluated rounds across six technical domains, including ML/MLOps, data engineering, systems and code, scientific computing, testing and automation, and infrastructure and security. Each task contains 5-15 rounds, with the same workspace and agent session preserved across rounds. Each round introduces a new requirement and uses cumulative test cases to verify the current and previous active requirements. A round receives a reward only when all test cases pass.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 EvoCode-Bench（Shen et al., 2026）上评估代码智能体，该基准包含 26 个有状态软件工程任务和横跨六个技术领域的 227 轮评估，领域包括机器学习/MLOps、数据工程、系统与代码、科学计算、测试与自动化，以及基础设施与安全。 每个任务包含 5-15 轮，且各轮之间保留相同的工作区和智能体会话。 每一轮都会引入一个新需求，并使用累积的测试用例来验证当前及之前仍然生效的需求。 只有当所有测试用例全部通过时，该轮才能获得奖励。

paragraphs.en: RepoTrace brings improvement on stronger models that can effectively exploit repository-level guidance, while the benefit is limited for models that struggle to utilize it. On DeepSeek-V4-Pro, RepoTrace raises MPR from 14.14 to 36.39 (+22.25, about 2.57 × 2.57\times ), with FCR and PTR improving by about 3 × 3\times and 4 × 4\times respectively. This shows that the traced repository-level guidance translates into both higher per-round success and more fully completed tasks. The benefit is limited for Qwen3.7-Max, suggesting that the advantage scales with the model’s ability to exploit the injected guidance. The extra token cost is acceptable. On DeepSeek-V4-Pro, RepoTrace reduces IT from 441.33M to 319.48M ( − 27.61 % -27.61\% ) while tripling MPR, since repository-level guidance prunes redundant exploration of the codebase. Considering that OT rises only moderately across all models and IT even decreases on the strongest performer, we regard the overall token overhead as acceptable. Overall, RepoTrace improves model performance on EvoCode-Bench with an acceptable efficiency cost.
paragraphs.zh: RepoTrace 能够为那些可以有效利用仓库级引导的更强模型带来提升，而对于难以利用该引导的模型，收益则较为有限。 在 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 上，RepoTrace 将 MPR 从 14.14 提升至 36.39（+22.25，约 2.57 倍），FCR 和 PTR 分别提升约 3 倍和 4 倍。 这表明所追踪的仓库级引导既转化为更高的单轮成功率，也转化为更多完整完成的任务。 对于 Qwen3.7-Max，收益较为有限，这表明其优势随模型利用注入引导的能力而扩展。 额外的 token 开销是可以接受的。 在 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 上，RepoTrace 将 IT 从 441.33M 降至 319.48M（−27.61%），同时使 MPR 提升至三倍，因为仓库级引导剪除了对代码库的冗余探索。 考虑到 OT 在所有模型上仅温和上升，且 IT 在表现最强的模型上甚至有所下降，我们认为整体 token 开销是可以接受的。 总体而言，RepoTrace 以可接受的效率开销提升了模型在 EvoCode-Bench 上的性能。

paragraphs.en: RepoTrace improves performance across different harnesses. On the weaker Terminus-2, RepoTrace raises MPR from 14.14 to 36.39 (about 2.57 × 2.57\times ) and PTR from 3.85 to 15.38 (about 4 × 4\times ). On Claude Code, RepoTrace further improves MPR from 44.65 to 54.87 (+10.22 points), suggesting that the repository-level context extracted by RepoTrace complements the context extracted by the harness (see RQ4 and Appendix A ). Token efficiency improves consistently as well when using DeepSeek-V4-Pro: IT decreases by 27.61 % 27.61\% on Terminus-2 and by 19.80 % 19.80\% on Claude Code, while OT rises only slightly on both harnesses. Overall, RepoTrace brings consistent improvement across harnesses at an acceptable efficiency cost.

paragraphs.en: RepoTrace mitigates error accumulation and regression across rounds. In contrast, RepoTrace maintains a mean reward between 0.29 and 0.50 and leads in all 10 rounds. The regression results further confirm this gap. Vanilla’s pass rate on the test cases of earlier rounds degrades from 84.68 at round 2 to only 14.62 at round 11, while RepoTrace keeps this rate above 80 in every round. Averaged over rounds 2 to 11, RepoTrace improves this pass rate from 57.06 to 89.46 (+32.40 points, a 56.78% relative improvement), which means fewer regression errors. paragraphs.en: In this section, we discuss 1) the applicability of RepoTrace and 2) the role of requirements in agentic software engineering.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们讨论 1）RepoTrace 的适用性，以及 2）需求在智能体软件工程中的作用。

paragraphs.en: As a requirement-driven repository understanding method, RepoTrace can be extended to different harnesses through the requirement-code correspondence produced by RepoTrace . Both humans and code agents can modify the correspondence, allowing RepoTrace to work with different harnesses without directly modifying their execution process. Deeper integration ( e.g., using hooks) may provide more control but reduce the range of applicable RepoTrace . Supporting a wider range of harnesses while maintaining effective integration remains an open problem.
paragraphs.zh: 作为一种需求驱动的代码仓库理解方法，RepoTrace 可以通过其产出的需求-代码对应关系扩展到不同的测试框架。 人类和智能体都可以修改该对应关系，使 RepoTrace 无需直接修改不同测试框架的执行流程即可与其协同工作。 更深度的集成（例如使用钩子）可能提供更多控制能力，但会缩小 RepoTrace 的适用范围。 在保持有效集成的同时支持更广泛的测试框架，仍是一个悬而未决的问题。

paragraphs.en: Requirements play a central role in agentic software engineering. Code agents need to translate requirements into code changes and retain previous requirements as the software evolves. As the interaction horizon grows, agents may get lost, focus on the most recent requirement, and miss requirements addressed in earlier rounds. Therefore, maintaining requirements throughout software development can help agents preserve their objectives while making new changes. More broadly, requirements provide a persistent source of objectives for agents to build on their previous experience, which is important for RSI.
paragraphs.zh: 需求在智能体软件工程中扮演着核心角色。 代码智能体需要将需求转化为代码变更，并在软件演进过程中保留先前的需求。 随着交互跨度的增长，智能体可能会迷失方向，只关注最近的需求，而遗漏在较早轮次中提出的需求。 因此，在整个软件开发过程中维护需求可以帮助智能体在进行新变更的同时保持其目标。 更广泛地说，需求为智能体提供了一个持久的目标来源，使其能够在先前经验的基础上继续构建，这对递归自我改进（RSI）非常重要。

paragraphs.en: We present RepoTrace , a requirement-driven repository understanding harness that improves requirement tracing in multi-round agent interactions. RepoTrace helps code agents focus on relevant code and preserve existing functionality across interactions. In future work, we plan to: 1) explore how to manage and abstract requirement changes through structured representations, as with code, and 2) study how RepoTrace can help promote RSI.

paragraphs.en: Under this setting, 2,132 of the 3,865 agent-modified source-file instances fall outside the oracle modification scope, yielding an off-oracle ratio of 55.16%.
paragraphs.zh: 在此设置下，3,865 个智能体修改的源文件实例中有 2,132 个落在 oracle 修改范围之外，产生 55.16% 的 off-oracle 比例。

paragraphs.en: This metric measures disagreement with the modification scope of the benchmark reference implementation; it does not assume that the oracle provides the only valid implementation. The analysis is path-based and does not distinguish content-equivalent, whitespace-only, or comment-only writes. It also cannot verify whether every statically detected command successfully modified the workspace. We therefore report 55.16% as a corpus-level static estimate rather than a full-corpus replay ground truth. In a 30-trajectory calibration, the static and replay estimates under the same failed-trajectory, non-Round-1 setting are 32.26% and 34.29%, respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 该指标衡量与基准参考实现的修改范围的不一致程度；它并不假定 oracle 提供的是唯一有效的实现。 该分析基于路径，不区分内容等价、仅空白字符或仅注释的写入。 它也无法验证每个静态检测到的命令是否都成功修改了工作区。 因此，我们将 55.16% 作为语料库层面的静态估计值进行报告，而非全语料库重放的基准真值。 在 30 条轨迹的校准中，相同失败轨迹、非第一轮设置下的静态估计值和重放估计值分别为 32.26% 和 34.29%。

paragraphs.en: Figures 10 and 11 show corresponding file-level details from the reconstructed function-call diagrams. The outer boxes group functions by file. Solid arrows denote cross-file calls, and dashed arrows denote calls within a file. The screenshots retain the original labels and show local regions of the larger diagrams; some cross-file arrows continue beyond the crop boundaries.
paragraphs.zh: 图10和图11展示了重建的函数调用图中对应的文件级细节。 外层方框按文件对函数进行分组。 实线箭头表示跨文件调用，虚线箭头表示文件内的调用。 截图保留了原始标签，并展示了较大图的局部区域；一些跨文件箭头延伸到了裁剪边界之外。
